scripts.text: A legend in the Novice world has disappeared to do something in Comodo.
scripts.translation: 初心者世界的一位传奇人物去了克魔岛办事，之后就失踪了。

scripts.text: Oh? Are you one of our Novice Society?
scripts.translation: 哦？你是初心者协会的成员吗？

scripts.text: You seem strong enough to endure the test.
I know a way to become stronger. Are you willing you try it?
scripts.translation: 我知道一种变强的方法。你愿意试试吗？
不用了，我现在这样就好

scripts.text: If you are satisfied with mediocrity, I can't help you.
scripts.translation: 如果你甘于平庸，我也帮不了你。
那就过普通人的生活吧。

scripts.text: A legend in the Novice world has disappeared to do something in Comodo.
scripts.translation: 初心者世界的一位传奇人物去了克魔岛办事，之后就失踪了。

scripts.text: They're swimmin' away bacause of the noise~
Why are you disrupting my fishing?
I have a delivery from Esseray...
^0000FFA member of Novice Society in Aldebaran.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF是艾尔帕兰初心者协会的成员。^000000

scripts.text: Hu hu~ my sense is still alive...
scripts.translation: 呼呼~我的直觉还挺灵的...

scripts.text: So what do you want from me?

scripts.translation: 那艾瑟雷是从哪里来的？
- 你解释了自己来这里的原因。 -

scripts.text: Hmm... it is an easy and hard question at the same time.
scripts.translation: 嗯...这问题说简单也简单，说难也难。

scripts.text: - You hear a voice complaining about something. -
Esseray! Such a son of a %@&$# spoiling my vacation...
scripts.translation: 艾瑟雷！那个该死的混蛋，竟然毁了我的假期...

scripts.text: Hey! I can see what you are thinking about in your face~
scripts.translation: 嘿！你心里想什么，全写在脸上了~

scripts.text: Since my name is Nodor I've been made fun of my whole life.
scripts.translation: 就因为我叫诺多尔，从小到大大家都拿我开玩笑。

scripts.text: Whatever the reason is... you are here!
scripts.translation: 不管你为什么来...反正你已经来了！

scripts.text: Let's get together to go further.
- Nodor gives you a suspicious look. -
Didn't you know that the ^0000FFSuper Novice^000000 was excellent?
scripts.translation: 你不知道^0000FF超级初心者^000000有多厉害吗？

scripts.text: Do you know who I am?
You've got a lot of nerve, don't you?
So will you believe what I tell you?
scripts.translation: 你愿意相信我说的话吗？

scripts.text: Refusing? Don't you want to be strong?
scripts.translation: 要拒绝我？你不想变强吗？

scripts.text: I'd love to do nothing too.
scripts.translation: 其实我也乐得什么都不做。

scripts.text: Just let me fish if you want to go.
scripts.translation: 你想走的话，就让我继续钓鱼吧。

scripts.text: Hmm, I can't help using such words.
scripts.translation: 没办法，我就是这副口气。

scripts.text: It's no problem for me to teach you to be stronger.
scripts.translation: 教你变强对我来说不算什么。

scripts.text: You don't know how to be stronger. Right?
scripts.translation: 是不知道怎么变强，对吧？

scripts.text: There's a way to do it...
It is dangerous, but I can
scripts.translation: 虽然很危险，不过我可以

scripts.text: I'll only do this on one condition. You do not ask anything and you do everything I tell you!
scripts.translation: 我只有一个条件：别问问题，我说什么你就做什么！

scripts.text: Are you willing to do this?
To be strong is the only way to live!
Do you want to be a weakling forever?
I will give you a tip.
Sometimes you need to check your ego and listen to others.
scripts.translation: 有时得放下自尊，听听别人的意见。

scripts.text: Your passion will make you stronger.
scripts.translation: 你的热情会让你变得更强。

scripts.text: What I want you to do is...
Do you know what this is for?
scripts.translation: 知道我为什么要你这么做吗？

scripts.text: You know what a ^FF0000{0}^000000 monster is, right?
Do not say you can't do this!
I know that's a lot of monsters, but they're so weak!
scripts.translation: 我知道数量不少，不过它们弱得很！

scripts.text: Don't come back until you've hunted 1,000.
scripts.translation: 没打倒1000只猎物之前，不准回来。
我不是叫你去猎杀1,000只吗？

scripts.text: Don't come back until you have.
You are better than I thought.
Anyway, what was the monster that I told you to hunt?
scripts.translation: 对了，我叫你猎杀什么魔物来着？

scripts.text: Heheh? Can you seriously hunt Baphomet alone?
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿？你真能独自猎杀巴风特？

scripts.text: Don't tell a lie!! I will hit you!!
I didn't tell you to hunt this!
scripts.translation: 我叫你猎杀的不是这个！

scripts.text: You annoyed me so I made you do this task...
scripts.translation: 你惹恼我了，所以我才故意给你这项任务...
哇！你居然真的猎杀完1,000只了？

scripts.text: I guess I can't question your passion to be stronger.
scripts.translation: 看来你想变强的决心确实不容小觑。

scripts.text: I will let you know how to overcome your strength deficiencies.
scripts.translation: 我来告诉你怎么弥补实力上的不足。

scripts.text: Didn't you say you have something to handle?
scripts.translation: 你不是说还有事情要处理吗？

scripts.text: I got a letter from my brother a long time ago, will you read my letter for your information?
scripts.translation: 我很久以前收到哥哥的一封信，你要不要读读看，了解一下情况？

scripts.text: - He throws a bundled letter at you. -
scripts.translation: - 他把一封卷起来的信扔给你。 -

scripts.text: Hey Bro, it's your brother Nudor. How have you been? The reason I'm writing this letter is...
scripts.translation: 嘿，哥哥，我是你弟弟努多尔。你最近怎么样？我写这封信是想...

scripts.text: I need money for food. You've got so much money, so help me out.
scripts.translation: 我需要钱买吃的。你那么有钱，帮帮我吧。

scripts.text: If you don't... Remember last time you %$&*@*&%$...
scripts.translation: 要是不帮我...还记得上次你%$&*@*&%$...

scripts.text: - The letter is crumpled, so you can't read more. -
scripts.translation: - 信被揉皱了，后面的内容看不清。 -

scripts.text: I'm still in the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 我还在修瓦尔茨巴尔德共和国。

scripts.text: - You get an uneasy feeling from reading this letter. -
scripts.translation: - 读完这封信，你感到一阵不安。 -

scripts.text: Hmm, I only have one brother and he's always asking for money.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我就一个弟弟，他总是找我要钱。

scripts.text: It's got to be my fame... T_T
scripts.translation: 一定是因为我太有名了... T_T

scripts.text: - Now you really have an uneasy feeling. -
scripts.translation: - 现在你真的感到不安了。 -

scripts.text: You can give some to my bro. He's up in the airship.
scripts.translation: 你可以给我哥哥一些钱。他在飞空艇上。

scripts.text: How much money should I give?
Oh, you didn't go there yet?
I got another message from my bro.
scripts.translation: 我又收到弟弟的消息了。

scripts.text: {0} Zeny is so little considering my celebrity status, don't you think?
scripts.translation: 考虑到我的名气，{0} Zeny也太少了吧？你说呢？

scripts.text: Don't you think you gave him too little? My reputation is gonna take a hit now.
scripts.translation: 你不觉得给得太少了吗？我的名声都要受影响了。

scripts.text: Wow, you've got my point already?
scripts.translation: 哇，你已经明白我的意思了？

scripts.text: This test is about your ability to open someone else's sympathy.
scripts.translation: 这项考验考的是你能不能唤起别人的同情心。

scripts.text: I mean your consuming habit and your gut...
scripts.translation: 我是说你的消费习惯和直觉...

scripts.text: you how to exceed your limit,
Eh-hem! I was not just killing time after I sent you!!
scripts.translation: 咳咳！我派你去可不是为了打发时间！！

scripts.text: Watch out!! A bunch of Golems are running after us!
scripts.translation: 小心！！一群巨石怪追过来了！

scripts.text: - When you are about to doubt... -
You've still got some skill points that aren't used up.
scripts.translation: 你还有没用完的技能点。

scripts.text: I can't make you stronger until you use those points.
scripts.translation: 用完这些点数之前，我没法让你变强。

scripts.text: I think our duty and mission as Novices is to make days joyful.
scripts.translation: 我觉得，初心者的职责和使命就是让每一天都充满欢乐。

scripts.text: Well then, don't you feel something just changed?
scripts.translation: 那么，你有没有感觉到变化？

scripts.text: Feel your body lighter than before...?
scripts.translation: 身体是不是比以前轻盈了...？
我不是故意冒犯你，不过
你现在不觉得自己不一样了吗？

scripts.text: Eh--- right, you are dull, aren't you?
You can be stronger than before.
Now march to the world and live as a Novice and enjoy your free, happy life!
scripts.translation: 去世界各地闯荡吧，继续做个初心者，享受自由快乐的生活！

scripts.text: To celebrate this new Novice comrade, I've prepared some equipment to give you --
scripts.translation: 为了庆祝又有一位初心者伙伴加入，我准备了一些装备送给你——

scripts.text: Don't forget to make sure that you have enough ^FF0000inventory^000000 to take these items from me.
scripts.translation: 记得确认^FF0000背包^000000里有足够空间，才能收下这些物品。

scripts.text: And don't say I didn't warn you either.
Yes, let me check my inventory.
There are what I used to wear when I was younger,
scripts.translation: 这些是我年轻时穿戴过的装备，

scripts.text: How can you react like that when I offer you my possessions?
scripts.translation: 我把自己的东西送给你，你怎么能这样反应？

scripts.text: I can't take back what I already gave away.
scripts.translation: 送出去的东西可不能收回来。

scripts.text: Now I am going to say greetings again.
scripts.translation: 现在，我要重新向你致意。

scripts.text: Let Super Novice {0} be blessed with the Super Novice Guardian!
scripts.translation: 愿超级初心者{0}获得超级初心者守护者的祝福！

scripts.text: Don't forget that you are a Novice.
The aim of life is to have a nice and normal time!
scripts.translation: 人生的目标就是过得自在、平凡！

scripts.text: Ahhh~ I have no money to buy any food.
I'm hungry, but I have no idea when Brother is coming...
scripts.translation: 我饿死了，可不知道哥哥什么时候才回来...

scripts.text: - You explain to Nudor why you have come to see him. -
scripts.translation: - 你向努多尔说明了来找他的原因。 -

scripts.text: Aha! You've come to give me some pocket money in place of my bro~
scripts.translation: 啊哈！你是替我哥哥来给我零花钱的吧~

scripts.text: Wowowow~~ How much did he give you?
- How much do you want to give? -
Give all the money you have
Lovely~~ Did he give you {0} Zeny? That's pretty much!
scripts.translation: 太好了~~他给了你{0}泽尼吗？这可不少呢！

scripts.text: Oh... oh my gosh, are you really giving me all the Zeny you have? Really?
scripts.translation: 哦...天哪，你真的要把身上所有泽尼都给我吗？真的吗？

scripts.text: Eh? But you don't have any money. You're so poor, huh?
scripts.translation: 咦？可你身上一分钱都没有。你这么穷啊？

scripts.text: Woa~!! {0} Zeny! This helped me so much~ Tehee~
scripts.translation: 哇~！！{0} Zeny！这可帮大忙了~嘿嘿~

scripts.text: Did you know? You're really handsome~
I need to tell you, you are really... really~ beautiful.
scripts.translation: 我得告诉你，你真的...真的~很漂亮。
- 你觉得自己好像被耍了，-

scripts.text: - tricked, so go back to Nodor. -
I cannot believe that my bro sent me money... I love it~
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信哥哥真的给我寄钱了...我太喜欢了~
别告诉诺多尔这件事哦~~

scripts.text: Ahhh~ I have no money to buy any food.
I'm hungry, but I have no idea when Brother is coming...
scripts.translation: 我饿死了，可不知道哥哥什么时候才回来...
